stages.name: data
stages.criteria: 100 demos: explicit object/goal/action/frame contracts, finite complete safety measurements and reviewed exclusions

stages.name: training
stages.criteria: one model first; held-out split and same-unit action MSE, optimizer update count, deterministic source/checkpoint hashes

stages.name: physical_pilot
stages.criteria: fixed seeds; actual completed trials, video and per-step metrics, no missingness or runtime failure

stages.name: formal_single_task
stages.criteria: 3 seeds x50 episodes with predeclared distribution, SR/SSR and uncertainty; task goal and active thresholds bound before scoring

stages.name: release_review
stages.criteria: all preceding stages accepted; no automatic scale launch from smoke or process exit

hold.next: Deploy isolated measured PP eval using original p9821 baseline; validate terminal telemetry before changing policy or training more models

reference_target.note: Minimum reproduction target; current pilot is not paper-comparable. Protocol/active constraint mapping must be bound before formal scoring. No lowering target after seeing results.
